investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB target backing POST /v1/agents — was unreachable from the production-api service at the time of the eval run. The gateway returned a 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning", causing the request to fail after ~11 seconds on all three checks. This is an infrastructure-layer failure localized to the swarm gateway / ELB endpoint, not to the eval runner logic or any eval configuration file. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact is scoped to this observability eval run.
